assert asset_in >= 0 && asset_in < n;: Defence in depth (TibetSwap V2 class). An out-of-range index fails nth_int's `first` of nil before this line matters; kept so the sign/index checks remain the defence if the bracket were ever widened.
assert asset_out >= 0 && asset_out < n;: As asset_in: nth_int raises on an out-of-range index; kept as the second layer.
assert gross_input > 0;: exact_swap_output is unsatisfiable for a non-positive input (brute-forced in the V12 mutation work); this line is the second layer, kept because TibetSwap V2 was drained by exactly its absence.
assert claimed_output > 0;: exact_swap_output is unsatisfiable for a non-positive output; second layer, same reason.
assert lp_delta > 0;: exact_invariant_lp_mint's lower bound refuses a non-positive mint for any deposit that raises the product; second layer.
assert any_positive(deposits);: An all-zero deposit leaves effective_product == old_product, and the bracket then admits no lp_delta > 0; also every zero slot binds no settlement, so nothing funds a mint. Second layer.
assert payout == 0;: A negative payout slot makes zip_sub's new reserve exceed the old, which exact_withdrawal refuses (pinned by 'a negative payout slot is refused'); a zero slot simply emits no CreateCoin. Structural.
assert CONFIG.dao_puzzle_hash != zero_by: A pool with no DAO recipient has dao_fee_bps == 0 in state (prologue line 370, killed), so `new_bps < current` refuses every decrease before this line is reached. Structural.
assert right is nil;: zip_add / zip_sub length checks. deposits or payouts longer than the reserves: the extra entries are unreachable by the reserve list, and deposit_asserts / payout_conditions walk the SOLUTION list against asset_ids and fail `first` of nil on the surplus; shorter lists fail the same way on the reserve side. Structural.
assert weights is nil;: spots_rest walks reserves against weights; both come from the curried config and the state whose shape the registry pinned at genesis and the finalizer rewrites from the same lists. Structural.
assert spot is nil;: credit walks cums against last_spot (killed) and spot; spot is computed by spots() from the same reserves, so its length is the reserves' by construction. Structural.
assert valid_config(config);: The config is curried into every leaf and the finalizer's binding; a different config is a different pool coin, and the registry refuses an out-of-bounds config at admission (registry suite: protocol recipient, floor, DAO-recipient probes). An unregistered pool with a bad config is a different puzzle nobody registered. Kept so a pool cannot move on a config the registry would not admit.
assert count_ints(state.reserves) == n;: The eve state's shape is fixed by the registry's eve_state_hash at genesis and rewritten by the finalizer from the same lists; a mis-sized state is a different puzzle hash. Structural.
assert count_ints(state.fees_owed) == n;: As reserves: shape fixed at genesis, rewritten by the finalizer. Structural.
assert count_ints(state.dao_owed) == n;: As reserves: shape fixed at genesis, rewritten by the finalizer. Structural.
assert state.dao_fee_bps >= 0;: Probed: _test_v14_dao_fee.py 'a swap on a pool with dao_fee_bps = -100 in state is refused'. If the run still reports UNREACHED, the registry's valid_pool (dao_fee_bps >= 0, killed) is the admission-time defence and the pool is unregistered.
assert settlement_coin_id != zero_bytes3: settlement_assert is only ever called with an id derived by coinid(), which is a sha256 output and never the zero hash. Structural since V14.
assert settlement_parent != zero_bytes32: A parent of zero derives the settlement id at coinid(0x00.., settle_ph, amount); no coin with a zero parent exists, so the concurrent-spend assertion has nothing to meet ON CHAIN. Offline, get_conditions_from_spendbundle does not know a coin cannot exist: a bundle that fabricates the zero-parent coin makes the announcement itself, and a mutant with this line deleted is ACCEPTED by the validator (probed 2026-09-19, audit run T-5). So this line is the only OFFLINE refusal and the coin store is the on-chain one -- two lanes, not two layers. Pinned by _test_v14_solution_widths.py, which now feeds the zero hash here and expects the leaf to refuse it, so the line reads KILLED.
assert settlement_amount > 0;: settlement_amount >= at_least (killed) with at_least = gross_input > 0 or deposit > 0 already refuses a non-positive amount. Second layer.
assert lp_parent_id != zero_bytes32();: lp_action_coin_id derives the mode-23 receiver from the parent, so the melt coin's REAL parent must equal it. A melt coin whose parent is the zero hash cannot carry a valid CAT lineage (its parent id would need a sha256 preimage), so the only way to build one is a melt with no CAT parent -- and the TAIL's `parent_is_cat || expected_delta > 0` (killed) refuses that melt before this line matters. Unlike the launcher-parent, grandparent and settlement-parent asserts, this one IS a second layer offline as well as on chain: probed 2026-09-19 (audit run T-5) by building exactly that melt against a mutant with the line deleted, and the TAIL refused it. The probe is _test_v14_solution_widths.py's zero-parent lane.
assert launcher_parent_id != zero_bytes3: The launcher id is derived from the parent; a zero parent derives a launcher no coin can be, so its announcement is never made ON CHAIN. Offline, get_conditions_from_spendbundle does not know a coin cannot exist: a bundle that fabricates the zero-parent coin makes the announcement itself, and a mutant with this line deleted is ACCEPTED by the validator (probed 2026-09-19, audit run T-5). So this line is the only OFFLINE refusal and the coin store is the on-chain one -- two lanes, not two layers. Pinned by _test_v14_solution_widths.py, which now feeds the zero hash here and expects the leaf to refuse it, so the line reads KILLED.
assert reserves is nil;: derived_reserve_parents / reserve_launch_asserts walk assets, reserves and grandparents in step; valid_pool (killed) already requires count(reserves) == count(assets), and a surplus grandparent or reserve is simply unused by an otherwise honest registration. Structural.
assert grandparents is nil;: As reserves: a surplus grandparent is unused; a missing one fails `first` of nil. Structural.
assert grandparent != zero_bytes32();: A zero grandparent derives P_i = coinid(0x00.., launcher_hash, amount), a coin that cannot exist, so the reserve-launch announcement is never made ON CHAIN. Offline, get_conditions_from_spendbundle does not know a coin cannot exist: a bundle that fabricates the zero-parent coin makes the announcement itself, and a mutant with this line deleted is ACCEPTED by the validator (probed 2026-09-19, audit run T-5). So this line is the only OFFLINE refusal and the coin store is the on-chain one -- two lanes, not two layers. Pinned by _test_v14_solution_widths.py, which now feeds the zero hash here and expects the leaf to refuse it, so the line reads KILLED.
assert inner_hashes is nil;: reserve_launch_asserts walks the derived parents against the inner hashes computed from the same asset list; equal length by construction. Structural.
assert amount > 0;: A zero-amount launcher creates a zero-amount reserve, which valid_pool's all_positive (killed) refuses at registration; and coinid() of a zero amount is a coin the registry never derives for a positive reserve. Second layer.
